supersedes: target-extension-freeze-04 after the preserved v1 p08 regression and v2 probe-ledger audit
logic_contract: single retains one claim; and/or contain only flat standalone branches; attribution contains one reporting parent plus flat conjunctive attributed-content children; conditional/comparison/causal retain one complete relation and require a relation-specific all-dimension probe; mixed fails closed without an expression tree.
identity_contract: entity_identity is same-referent matching and accepts exact mention, alias, unambiguous description or anaphora. exact_designation is permitted only for an explicit naming predicate. Overlapping nested identity spans are rejected.
result_contract: Evidence and world return exactly one grounded result per projected probe. Python validates plan checksum, projections, bindings, result relations and basis, then deterministically aggregates; the model cannot choose or override the overall verdict.
loop_contract: Every returned snapshot is decomposed again. Probe-owned gaps are linked to one unresolved probe. Each round recomputes whether prior active gaps still block; nondecisive unresolved branches become nonblocking without being falsely marked resolved, and conclusive probe results close their prior tasks with current basis.

gate.execution: p02 and p08 must both complete two rounds with no call error, model mismatch or budget overrun; returned responses must equal attempts and checkpoints must be rounds 1 and 2.
gate.labels: p02 round1 and final must be false; p08 round1 and final must be true. Smoke accuracy must be 2/2 with zero fixes and zero breaks against both completed baselines.
gate.probe_audit: Both plans must pass independent v2 SHA, target-anchor, binding, projection and program-policy validation. Four accepted verification cycles must have exactly-one result-slot coverage 1.0 and grounded-conclusive rate 1.0.
gate.p02: Exactly one attribution parent and at least one linked attributed-content child; no parent dimension may extend past 'reported that'. Final-total, Bennu, OSIRIS-REx and 70.3 grams belong to content. Every round must ground the contradicted final-total obligation in m03.
gate.p08: No overlapping entity/designation spans and no exact_designation probe. The map-product entity probe must use same_referent and be supported in both evidence rounds from m15 by exact/alias/description/anaphora, with no identity gap. No fetch may repeat an already-visible m14/m15 URL. The graph must retain m14 to m15 direct citation and m15 as origin.
gate.failure_policy: Any failed conjunct preserves smoke-01 and stops the full run. A code or prompt change requires freeze-06 and a fresh smoke-02 directory. No failed run is overwritten.

proof_limit: The two-case gate detects the known regression and the eight seen development cases can show recovery or non-regression only. Neither proves an accuracy increase; that requires event-disjoint, independently adjudicated held-out cases.
